title: The crossing number of the complete graph minus an edge
author: Myeongjin Kang
third_party_rights: retained; no third-party text or upstream file in the public payload

scope.theorem_A: for every integer n >= 2 and every edge e of K_n, cr(K_n - e) = Z(n) - C(floor((n-1)/2), 2); ordinary drawings, no restriction on vertex positions or edge routes
scope.corollary_B: for all m >= 4 and n >= 1, P_n the path with n edges, cr(K_m box P_n) = (1/4) floor((m+1)/2) floor((m-1)/2) floor((m-2)/2) (n floor((m+4)/2) + floor((m-4)/2)), via Ouyang-Wang-Huang 2014 Corollary 5.1 (cited, not re-audited)
scope.new_part: lower bound cr(K_{2s+1} - e) >= C(s,2)^2 - C(s,2) for s >= 7 (odd n >= 15); Corollary B new exactly for odd m >= 13
scope.premises: Premises U1-U6 from openai/math fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb, stipulated true
